### VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics (victoriametrics/vmagent)

### [`v1.154.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/compare/v1.153.0...v1.154.0)

#### [v1.154.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.0)

Released at 2026-10-09

- SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.1 to Go1.27.2. See [the list of issues addressed in Go1.27.2](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.2%20label%3ACherryPickApproved).

- SECURITY: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): slow down requests with invalid auth tokens even if `unauthorized_user` has URLs configured. Previously, such requests were proxied to `unauthorized_user` without delay, which allowed brute-forcing auth tokens. See [GHSA-rpfx-hrcp-f73x](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/security/advisories/GHSA-rpfx-hrcp-f73x).

- SECURITY: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): prevent [cross-site scripting (XSS)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross-site_scripting) on Metric Relabling Debug, Query Analyzier, and Dashboards pages. See [GHSA-m2x2-9xpq-mmq5](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/security/advisories/GHSA-m2x2-9xpq-mmq5).

- FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/),`vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): add `/influx/ping` endpoint, which returns the `X-Influxdb-Version` HTTP header. Some [InfluxDB](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/influxdb/) clients, such as the Jenkins InfluxDB plugin, read the server version from this endpoint. See [#​11663](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11663). Thanks to [@​Vandit1604](https://redirect.github.com/Vandit1604) for contribution.

- FEATURE: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): add `oidc.auth_params` option to [SSO](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#single-sign-on-sso) config for passing additional query parameters to the IdP authentication request, e.g., `hd` for narrowing the Google account chooser to a single domain. Combine it with `match_claims` to enforce the domain restriction. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#sso-authentication-request-parameters) for more examples of `oidc.auth_params` usage.

- FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): abort incoming requests when a client disconnects and during graceful shutdown. See [#​11472](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11472).

- FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): cancel query requests if client disconnects. See [#​11355](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11355).

- BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: correctly configure TCP keep-alive active probes. See [#​11695](redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11695).

- BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: properly match regexps that start with an alternation or a character class and continue with `.*foo.*` or `.+foo.+`, for example `(a|b).*foo.*`. Previously the leading part was ignored when matching [relabeling](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/relabeling/) `regex` and `if` filters and [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/) `match` filters, so such rules matched more series than intended. See [#​11712](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11712). Thanks to [@​dblackdblack](https://redirect.github.com/dblackdblack) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [alerts](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules): fix  incorrect results for `TooHighChurnRate` and `TooHighSlowInsertsRate` in [cluster alerting rules](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-cluster.yml). Previously due to incorrect expressions, these rules stayed inactive since [v1.108.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.108.0) and could produce false positives since [v1.153.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.153.0). See [#​11670](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11670). Thanks to [@​transacid](https://redirect.github.com/transacid) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): properly add timeseries for [increase](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/configuration/#increase), [increase_prometheus](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/configuration/#increase_prometheus), [total](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/configuration/#total) and [total_prometheus](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/configuration/#total_prometheus) aggregation functions when `enable_windows: true` is set. See [#​11707](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11707). Thanks to [@​Hoipang](https://redirect.github.com/Hoipang) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): keep using notifiers from the previously applied [notifier configuration file](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/#notifier-configuration-file) if the updated config fails to start, for example due to a temporary service discovery error, and retry applying it on the next reload. Previously, vmalert stopped the old notifiers before starting the new ones, so a failed reload left vmalert with no or only some notifiers, and alert notifications were silently not delivered until the file changed or vmalert restarted. See [#​11645](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11645).

- BUGFIX: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): copy alert labels before applying `alert_relabel_configs` from the [notifier configuration file](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/#notifier-configuration-file), preventing different alertmanagers from affecting each other's labels. See [#​11676](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11676).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): set the `Host` HTTP request header to the resolved DNS SRV target instead of the SRV name when the url uses the `srv+` prefix. Previously requests could fail at reverse proxies and load balancers, which route by the `Host` header. See [#​8965](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/8965).

- BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): fixes rare data corruption on HTTP request retries. See [#​11508](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11508).

- BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): fix [SSO](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#single-sign-on-sso) login failure `Invalid state parameter` caused by a race condition when multiple concurrent unauthenticated requests each set their own CSRF cookie. See [#​10278-comment](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/10278#issuecomment-5862232663) and [#​11656](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11656).

- BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): fix misleading `missing 'Authorization' request header` response for [JWT-authenticated](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#jwt-token-auth-proxy) users when the requested path does not match any `url_map`. Now it correctly returns `400 Bad Request` with `missing route` error, matching the behavior of [Basic Auth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#basic-auth-proxy) and [Bearer-token](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#bearer-token-auth-proxy) users. See [#​11523](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11523).

- BUGFIX: [vmbackup](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmbackup/) and [vmbackupmanager](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmbackupmanager/): add `-s3SkipTaggingDirective` command-line flag for S3-compatible storage that rejects the `x-amz-tagging-directive` and `x-amz-tagging` headers. See [#​11562](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11562).

- BUGFIX: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): add missing `accountID`, `projectID` and `multiTenant` fields to `topByAvgMemoryUsage` results at `/api/v1/status/top_queries`. See [#​11640](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11640).

- BUGFIX: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent rare resource leak if `-search.skipSlowReplicas` flag is set. See [#​11551](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11551).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly execute `group_left(...)` and `group_right(..)` queries when the join is then combined with another selector. See [#​11490](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11490).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent possible crash with `cannot decompress zstd data...` panic on `darwin`, `windows`, `freebsd`, `openbsd`, `linux/arm`, `linux/ppc64le`, `linux/386`, `linux/s390x`, and `-pure` builds. The `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` builds are not affected. See [#​11683](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11683).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): properly apply `-streamAggr.enableWindows` command-line flag to [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/) rules. Previously, the flag was ignored by aggregation rules defined in `-streamAggr.config` and was applied only during config validation with `-dryRun` and to the standalone deduplication configured via `-streamAggr.dedupInterval`. See [#​11717](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11717).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly release memory after historical [data backfilling](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/#backfilling). Previously storage kept 8MiB\*CPU memory for each month of ingested data until restart. See [#​11672](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11672). Thanks to [@​mars71003219](https://redirect.github.com/mars71003219) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): prevent overriding the `serverUrl`, `tenantId`, `theme`, and `isDarkTheme` settings via query parameters. See [#​11485](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11485#issuecomment-5779024739).

### [`v1.153.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.153.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/compare/v1.152.0...v1.153.0)

#### [v1.153.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.153.0)

Released at 2026-09-28

**Update Note 1:** [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), `vmstorage`, `vmselect` and `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/), and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): builds without CGO (pure Go) may fail to read valid data blocks with the `window size exceeded` error. This can break queries, background merges and [native import](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-import-data-in-native-format), and can make `vmsingle` and `vmstorage` crash. Affected official builds: `darwin`, `windows`, `freebsd`, `openbsd`, `linux/arm`, `linux/ppc64le`, `linux/386`, `linux/s390x`, and `-pure` builds. The `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` builds use CGO and are not affected. Users of affected builds should not upgrade to this release, or should roll back to [v1.152.0](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/changelog/#v11520). See [#​11683](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11683).

- SECURITY: `vminsert`, [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): properly apply memory limits to the `zstd` encoded blocks ingested via [native import](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-import-data-in-native-format). This prevents excessive memory allocation during ingestion when handling maliciously crafted requests. See [GHSA-8g4f-32hw-vqf8](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/security/advisories/GHSA-8g4f-32hw-vqf8).

- SECURITY: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): restrict redirects in the [OIDC Discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#oidc-discovery) HTTP client to stay within the original request host. See [GHSA-xxqh-2hcc-9fp6](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/security/advisories/GHSA-xxqh-2hcc-9fp6).

- SECURITY: upgrade base docker image (Alpine) from 3.24.1 to 3.24.2. See [Alpine 3.24.2 release notes](https://www.alpinelinux.org/posts/Alpine-3.24.2-released.html).

- FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): skip a redundant pending state when an alert can be [restored](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/#alerts-state-on-restarts) directly to firing after restart. See [#​11401](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11401).

- FEATURE: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): log informative message when a JWT token has no `vm_access` claim and `default_vm_access_claim` is not configured, if `-logInvalidAuthTokens` is enabled. See [JWT claim-based request templating](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#jwt-claim-based-request-templating) or [#​11579](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11579).

- FEATURE: [dashboards/vmauth](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/tree/master/dashboards/vmauth.json): update the dashboard to upstream Grafana version, fix typos and inconsistencies, improve resource usage panels. See [#​11587](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11587)

- FEATURE: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): support printing HTTP headers in the [Access Logs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#access-log). Only headers listed in `access_log.headers` list will be printed in the logs. This feature should help troubleshooting pipelines that rely on HTTP headers. See [#​11598](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11598).

- FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): move auto-refresh controls from the header to the `Execute` button dropdown and display the selected interval in the button text. See [#​11343](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11343).

- FEATURE: `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): support ingesting data directly via Prometheus Remote Write v1 protocol for `vmstorage`. This feature can be enabled by setting `-enableIngestionAPI` command-line flag and is disabled by default. See [remote write directly to vmstorage](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/data-ingestion/vmagent/#remote-write-directly-to-vmstorage) and [#​11252](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11252).

- FEATURE: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): add [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#single-sign-on-sso) support via OpenID Connect (OIDC). vmauth redirects unauthenticated browser requests to the configured Identity Provider (IdP), verifies the IdP response, and sets a session cookie for subsequent requests. See [#​10278](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/10278).

- FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): add support for opt-in [fadvise(FADV_RANDOM)](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/posix_fadvise.2.html) and [madvise(MADV_RANDOM)](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/madvise.2.html) hints for data part files, which can reduce disk I/O and improve page cache efficiency. To enable, set `-fs.disableAdviseRandomRead=false`. If you experience issues after enabling this feature, please [leave a comment](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11461) with details. See [#​11461](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11461).

- BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: create the Unix domain socket for `-httpListenAddr=unix:/path/to/socket` with permissions according to the [umask](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umask) of the process. Previously it was always created with `0600` permissions, so processes running under other users, such as a reverse proxy, couldn't connect to it. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#security) and [#​11615](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11615).

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): serially push samples to [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/) jobs. This helps reduce CPU overhead. [11f488d8ff](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/commit/11f488d8ff) introduced parallel processing for this stage, which introduced extra CPU overhead while only providing negligible sample lag reduction. See [#​9878](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/9878#issuecomment-5692311649).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add missing `X-Influxdb-Version` HTTP header to [influxdb](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/influxdb/) API responses. See [#​11570](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11570).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): disable metrics metadata sending for [MDX](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#monitoring-data-exchange) remote write destinations. See [#​11572](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11572).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): properly discover `*_sd_config` targets. Previously scrape targets were preserved until the process restart if `*_sd_config` returned an empty targets response. See [#​11550](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11550) for details. Thanks to [@​evkuzin](https://redirect.github.com/evkuzin) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): properly reload SSL certificate for [kafka producer and consumer](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/). See [#​11577](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11577).

- BUGFIX: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): properly reload `alert_relabel_configs` from the [notifier configuration file](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/#notifier-configuration-file). Previously, this config was applied only at startup and was not updated on config reload. See [#​11635](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11635).

- BUGFIX: `vmselect`, `vminsert`, [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): ignore empty `extra_label`, `extra_filters` and `extra_filters[]` query args instead of returning an error. This allows dropping client-provided values for these query args via `url_prefix` in vmauth as described in the [security](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#security) docs. See [#​11618](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11618).

- BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): respect the `-enableTCP6` flag when discovering backend IPs via [`discover_backend_ips`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#discovering-backend-ips) or `-discoverBackendIPs`. Previously, discovery included IPv6 addresses even when IPv6 support was disabled. See [#​11470](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11470).

- BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): fix synchronization of the custom query step with URL changes on the predefined dashboards page. See [#​11137](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11137#issuecomment-5396835285).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): slightly reduce CPU usage during concurrent queries execution. See [#​11569](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11569).
title: chore(deps): update victoriametrics/vmagent docker tag to v1.154.0
